about: Shared cases for the "Posso operar hoje?" domain (app/lib/domain/gate) and the SQL. Inputs are invented; every "expected" value was computed by the SQL functions named in each group (migrations 20261018000001..3 of fase-2/banco and 20261019000001 of fase-2b/banco), so the TypeScript test (cases.test.ts) checks that both sides give the same answer. Instants are UTC; "local" says how each was written. Rows with "sql" are the same inputs the database test asserts. The Phase 2b rows (Forex, Ações, Cripto, B3, Opções) follow the Phase 2 rows in each group.
